in_hebrew.name: קאלווין
in_hebrew.meaning: קאלווין הוא שם נוצרי שמשמעותו 'קישוט' או 'נוי'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קאלווין הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשפה הלטינית, והוא משמש כחלופה לשם העברי 'קאלוו'. השם קאלווין מתקשר לקונספט של קישוט או נוי, ויש לו שורשים בשפה הלטינית. השם היה בשימוש נרחב בקרב הנוצרים בימי הביניים והוא עדיין בשימוש כיום.

in_greek.name: Καλβίνος
in_greek.meaning: Ο Καλβίνος σημαίνει 'kosmos' ή 'kompos' που σημαίνει στολίσματος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Καλβίνος είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το λατινικό 'Calvinus', που σημαίνει 'kosmos' ή 'kompos', δηλαδή στολίσματος ή διακόσμηση. Το όνομα Καλβίνος έχει τις ρίζες του στη λατινική γλώσσα και ήταν ευρέως διαδεδομένο στην αρχαία Εκκλησία. Σήμερα, το όνομα Καλβίνος εξακολουθεί να χρησιμοποιείται ευρέως μεταξύ των χριστιανών.

in_latin.name: Calvinus
in_latin.long_meaning: Calvinus est nomen christianum quod originem habet in lingua latina, et significat 'ornamentum' vel 'decoratio'. Nomen Calvinus habet radices in lingua latina et fuit in usu amplo apud christianos in medio aevo. Hodie, nomen Calvinus adhuc in usu est inter christianos.

in_english.name: Calvin
in_english.meaning: Calvin means 'bald' or 'hairless', but also 'little calves'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Calvin is of Latin origin, derived from 'Calvinus', which means 'bald' or 'hairless'. However, some sources also link it to 'calf', suggesting a connection to 'little calves'. In Christian tradition, Calvin has been associated with John Calvin, a prominent 16th-century French theologian and pastor. The name Calvin conveys a sense of simplicity, humility, and devotion to faith.

data.cultural_impact: John Calvin (1509-1564) was a significant figure in the Protestant Reformation, a movement that sought to reform the Catholic Church and bring it closer to the teachings of the Bible. Calvin is best known as the primary advocate of the doctrine of predestination, which holds that God has already determined who will be saved and who will be damned, before the foundation of the world. This concept, along with his emphasis on the sufficiency of Scripture and the importance of individual faith, had a profound impact on Protestant theology and the development of Presbyterian and Reformed traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian context, the name Calvin carries the spiritual significance of deep theological reflection, commitment to the teachings of the Bible, and a conviction to live a life centered on God's grace and sovereignty. John Calvin's doctrines continue to be taken seriously by many Protestant and Reformed denominations, and his legacy continues to shape the way many Christians understand God's role in their lives. "Calvin" represents a deep dedication to God and a firm belief in His omniscience and sovereignty.

historical_references.reference: John Calvin (1509-1564) was a French theologian, pastor, and reformer during the Protestant Reformation.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Calvin remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Peter Calvin from Dublin, Ireland embodies the meaning of Calvin - "Little, devoted". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Calvin represents the Reformed theological tradition, emphasizing God's sovereignty and human depravity. Named after John Calvin, a key figure in the Protestant Reformation, his teachings continue to shape Protestant Christianity.
